view.summary: Scratch lottery tickets to collect T.T. STAR merch, then decorate a merch bag with it. Collecting more designs pays rewards; playing the lottery more unlocks new bags and ribbons.

overview.title: What is a merch bag?
items: Collect T.T. STAR merch to decorate your merch bag.
You can obtain merch through events and use the Decorate option to decorate your bag.
Put together a merch bag for your favorite group member.
You can acquire scratch tickets by opening up the merch bag page once a day, and by finding lost relics out in the field.
Scratch tickets can be used to get merch.
Collect merch to earn rewards.

overview.title: The lottery
items: Ticket
1 T.T. STAR Scratch Ticket per play
Each play
Opens a pack of merch (pack size 10; meaning not fully confirmed)
Box
1,374 pieces of merch in 54 designs; what you draw leaves the box
Daily gift
5 tickets a day for opening the merch bag page, 10 from 2026-05-06 20:00
Other tickets
Found as lost relics in the event field
Unlocks
Opens after clearing an event field stage (110810105)

overview.title: What is in the box
overview.note: Share = copies ÷ all copies, assuming every copy is equally likely (the per-design weights in the box list are not explained in-game).

overview.title: The bag
items: Grid
8 × 6 cells (from the layout check data)
Merch types
Doll: inside or on top; Pin Button: inside the clear cover; Photocard: inside the clear cover; Acrylic Stand: on top of the cover
